name: File Management
description: Create, copy, move, delete files and folders, manage permissions, extended attributes, filesystem attributes, and compression

operations.name: read
operations.description: Read the contents of a file

operations.name: write
operations.description: Write content to a file (creates or overwrites)

operations.name: edit
operations.description: Edit a file — replace text, append, insert, or delete lines

operations.name: permissions
operations.description: Change file or directory permissions and ownership

operations.name: compress
operations.description: Compress files or directories into an archive

operations.name: find
operations.description: Search for files by name, size, date, type, or content

operations.name: disk_usage
operations.description: Analyze disk usage for a path

operations.name: upload
operations.description: Upload a file to the server (binary-safe, base64-encoded). Use this when the user wants to transfer a file to the server — e.g. deploy a website zip, upload a config file, etc.

operations.name: download
operations.description: Download a file from the server (binary-safe, base64-encoded). Use this when the user wants to retrieve a file — e.g. download a config, get a log file, etc.

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a file management agent. Always verify paths exist before operating on them. Use <write> to create files and <edit> to modify them — these are safer than shell commands for file content. When deleting, list what will be deleted first. For compression, verify source exists and check available disk space. When changing permissions recursively, distinguish between files and directories (755 for dirs, 644 for files is common). Use 'du -sh' to check disk usage before large operations.
